# design_matrices { #formulae.design_matrices }

```python
design_matrices(formula, data, na_action='drop', env=0, extra_namespace=None)
```

Parse and materialize a model formula into a `DesignMatrices`.

A `DesignMatrices` object contains objects representing the response and
the design matrices for both the common and group specific effects.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**formula**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A model formula.

<code>[**data**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[pandas](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The data frame where variables in the formula are taken from.

<code>[**na_action**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'drop\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Describes what to do with missing values in `data`. `"drop"` means to drop all rows with a missing value, `"error"` means to raise an error, `"pass"` means to keep all. Defaults to `"drop"`.

<code>[**env**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[integer](`integer`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The number of environments we walk up in the stack starting from the function's caller to capture the environment where formula is evaluated. Defaults to 0 which means the evaluation environment is the environment where `design_matrices` is called.

<code>[**extra_namespace**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[dict](`dict`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Additional user supplied transformations to include in the environment where the formula is evaluated. Defaults to `None`.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**design**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[DesignMatrices](`formulae.matrices.DesignMatrices`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An instance of `DesignMatrices` that contains the design matrix or matrices described by `formula`.
